reference: fixed canonical v1.0 3 s prompt waveform for every arm

guardrail_wer.verdict: not applicable (no SIM gain to trade for)

exploratory_3s_minus_1p5s.label: EXPLORATORY — the in-distribution contrast; not the pre-registered comparison (§1.6: invented mid-flight, exploratory permanently)

reference_confound.check: every arm scored against the same fixed 3 s reference; no arm is ever scored against its own conditioning audio
reference_confound.evidence: scores.json for all four arms embeds items[n]['prompt_id'] audio

train_test_prompt_length_shift.check: DegenRate by arm (a shift that only breaks WER should show up here)
train_test_prompt_length_shift.note: DegenRate stays under 1.6 % in every arm while WER rises from 0.147 to 0.864 — the long-context failure is NOT degenerate output under the §6.4 rule; it is fluent speech that has stopped tracking the target text (see mechanism below)

mechanism_content_drift.check: is the long-context output reading the CONTEXT text instead?
mechanism_content_drift.reading: no — at 9 s the output matches the prompt text even worse than the target text, so it is not copying the context; it is fluent, speaker-consistent, correctly-timed speech that has decoupled from the phoneme conditioning entirely

H_S1.rule: primary: paired per-run SIM-o(9s) - SIM-o(3s), run-level bootstrap 95% CI > 0. second lens: Spearman trend over {1.5,3,6,9} positive in >= 12/15 runs. Both must agree in direction (PREREGISTRATION-v1.2.md H-S1).
